title: fix(settings): settings copy is written in all eleven platform languages, zh-TW reads Traditional, and sms/test answers in the caller's language (#30630)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D9ZFYWnf6P6tsGrp2D14eMY)_

Fixes #30630

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置里 7 张"按调用者语言写"的文案表（IP 白名单拒存、登录方式下限、两处 MFA 拒存与开启提示、邮件实时投递状态与测试邮件答复、默认币种锁定、"已不再提供"）补齐平台 11 种语言；"发送测试短信"改为按调用者语言答复；设置服务自带的"重置"结果与"未注册处理程序"也按语言答复。
- 为什么改：这些表只有 4 种（邮件只有 2 种）语言，法语、德语、韩语等用户看到英文；繁体中文（zh-TW）用户被回成简体；测试短信从不读语言，永远英文。
- 风险与回滚：只改文案与选语言的查表，不改任何判定、错误码或接口；英文原句逐字不变。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-sms/src/sms-plugin.ts`（测试短信接上语言）；`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts` 的 `runAction` 两处内置答复；`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/settings-copy-locale.test.ts`（逐表 11 语言 pin）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-sms exec vitest run src/sms-test-recipient.pin.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中 zh-TW 的测试短信答复以「測試簡訊已傳送至」开头。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Every module-local settings copy table (sentences composed per request, which the console's translation bundle cannot carry) now has one entry per language on the platform locale table (`PLATFORM_LOCALES`: `en`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `es`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ja`, `ko`). The four languages the tables served first keep their codes (`zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`); the rest use the table's tags, the shape `storage/test` uses (PR #30627). Translations are real text in every language, with no English fill.

The seven tables the card names, measured on `origin/main` (`grep` for the four-locale key sets and for `resolveLocale` callers in the three packages):

| Package | Table | Before |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plugin-auth` | `allowed-ip-ranges.ts` save refusal (now exported as `ALLOWED_IP_RANGES_REFUSAL_COPY` for its pin) | 4 |
| `plugin-auth` | `sign-in-method-floor.ts` `SIGN_IN_FLOOR_COPY` | 4 |
| `plugin-auth` | `mfa-required-enrollment-predicate.ts` `MFA_REQUIRED_ENROLLMENT_COPY` | 4 |
| `plugin-auth` | `organization-mfa-enrollment-guard.ts` refusal + save notice (two tables, one lookup) | 4 |
| `plugin-email` | `live-transport-status.ts` `MAIL_DELIVERY_COPY` | 2 (`en`, `zh-CN`) |
| `service-settings` | `localization-currency-lock.ts` `CURRENCY_LOCK_COPY` | 4 |
| `service-settings` | `localization-locale-options.ts` `NOT_OFFERED_COPY` | 4 |

The lookup stays core's `resolveLocale`. #30538 is closed and its fix landed: `resolveLocale` is now `resolveLocaleAmong`, which reads a code through the platform table's read aliases before the base-language and variant steps. So with a `zh-Hant` key present, `zh-TW` / `zh-HK` / `zh-MO` reach it and never `zh-CN`; `pt` reaches `pt-BR`; a code naming no table language answers `undefined`, which every table serves in English. No per-table copy of the reader was added.

- **`sms/test`** (`service-sms`): the handler now reads the action input's `locale` (the route passes `Accept-Language`, else `?locale`) and writes every answer from a new eleven-language table, `sms-test-copy.ts`: the five recipient refusals, missing credential, transport build failure, log-only warning, sent, and failed. A provider's or the engine's own error text passes through verbatim, behind a lead-in outside English. The English sentences are byte-identical to before.
- **The two built-in settings answers** (`service-settings`, `SettingsService.runAction`): the built-in `reset` result and "No handler registered for action ..." are written from a new eleven-language table, `settings-action-copy.ts`, in `display.locale`. English unchanged.
- One type per package names the eleven keys (`settings-copy-locale.ts` in `plugin-auth` and `service-settings`, `MailDeliveryCopyLocale`, `SmsTestCopyLocale`), so a table missing a language fails `tsc`. Arabic and Russian counts (MFA grace days, currency usage, reset count) use their plural forms.

## Why

A Setup caller in French, German, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese or Traditional Chinese read these sentences in English (or, for `zh-TW`, in Simplified Chinese), and `sms/test` ignored the caller's language entirely. The eleven-language rule (ruling F of #29349) holds every surface to the platform table.

## Tests

- New pins, one per table, each asserting: exactly one entry per platform table language; every field present and non-empty in every entry and different from English (no fill); each table tag and each stored alias (`zh-TW`, `zh-HK`, `zh-CN`, `zh`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`, `pt`, `en-US`, `fr-CA`, `de-AT`) served its own language; `zh-TW` never served the Simplified entry; an off-table code (`xx`, `sw-KE`) and no code served English.
  - `plugin-auth/src/settings-copy-locale.test.ts` (5 tables), plus Russian/Arabic plural cells.
  - `plugin-email/src/live-transport-status.pin.test.ts` (new top-level `describe` in the existing harness).
  - `service-settings/src/settings-copy-locale.test.ts` (currency lock, not-offered, built-in action answers).
  - `service-sms/src/sms-test-copy.test.ts`, including the English sentences pinned byte-identical.
- Served doors: `service-sms/src/sms-test-recipient.pin.test.ts` drives the real settings route with an `Accept-Language` header: `zh-TW,zh;q=0.9` answers "測試簡訊已傳送至 …，經由 twilio（id=SM_test）。"; `fr`, `de-DE`, `ko` refusals are in those languages and send nothing; no header and `sw-KE` stay English. `service-settings/src/settings-service.test.ts` pins the reset result in `zh-TW` and `ru` and the no-handler refusal in `de-DE`, English for none / `sw-KE`.
- Updated pins that encoded the four-language state: the currency-lock coverage pin (was "exactly the bundle's four locales") and its `fr-FR` row (was English); the email control (`fr-FR` was English, now `sw-KE`); the `mfa_required` and organization-MFA unknown-locale cells (`fr-FR` → `sw-KE`, `fr-FR` now French, `zh-TW` added); the organization notice's "1 is a digit in every language" cell accepts Arabic's word form for one day ("يوم واحد").

## Acceptance notes

- **Overlap with open PR #30448** (`allowed-ip-ranges.ts`): it rewrites the `recovery` sentence in the four languages it had. This PR translates the current one-step recovery into the seven new languages. Whichever lands second owes the four-step recovery in all eleven; a text conflict on the `es-ES` hunk is possible.
- **`zh-Hant-TW` / `zh-Hans-CN` are not read through the table** by the shared resolver: `resolveLocaleAmong`'s table step looks the whole code up, misses, and the variant step returns the first `zh*` key, `zh-CN`. A caller whose display language is `zh-Hant-TW` therefore still reads Simplified here and in every other bundle the resolver serves. The resolver lives in `packages/spec` (outside this card's file surface); reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- Labels the copy names on screen ("Send test SMS", "Setup → Authentication", the mail provider "None (log only)") come from the settings translation bundle, which ships four languages (#30512's surface). In the seven new languages the copy describes those controls instead of quoting a label the console does not show in that language.
- The SMS body sent to the phone (`ObjectStack SMS test message.`) is unchanged: it is the message, not the answer.

## Verification

Head `b1014f4d` (`a54649c1` the fix, `c3f79fc1` a merge of `origin/main` at `badf24df`, then two test-only commits). Readings under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` on a shared box.

<details><summary>Repro on origin/main (base 4bf9a2d7)</summary>

With the nine edited sources restored to the base (`git restore --source=4bf9a2d7`, tests from this branch), restored afterwards with `git checkout HEAD -- packages` and `git diff HEAD` empty:

- `signInFloorCopy('zh-TW')` is the `zh-CN` entry (Simplified); `signInFloorCopy('fr')` is English; the table's keys are `en,zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES`.
- `sms/test` through the served route with `Accept-Language: zh-TW,zh;q=0.9` answered `Sent test SMS to +8613*******01 via twilio (id=SM_test).`
- The new pins on the base: plugin-auth 22 failed / 27, service-sms 4 failed (served door), service-settings 8 failed / 156, plugin-email 4 failed / 21.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor 1 → 0, restored to the HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty; tests import src/)</summary>

| Ablated | Red |
| --- | --- |
| `sign-in-method-floor.ts`: the lookup reads only the four old keys (`resolveLocale(locale, ['en','zh-CN','ja-JP','es-ES'])`) | 2 of 26 in `settings-copy-locale.test.ts` (tags/aliases served their own language; zh-TW never Simplified) |
| `sms-plugin.ts`: the handler ignores the input locale (`smsTestCopy(undefined)`) | 4 of 16 in `sms-test-recipient.pin.test.ts` (zh-TW sent, fr / de-DE / ko refusals) |

</details>

<details><summary>Suites and typecheck</summary>

After the merge of `origin/main`: closure build of the four packages (`pnpm --filter 'PKG^...' … build`) exit 0, then per package typecheck (with `check:test-typecheck`) and `pnpm --filter PKG test`:

- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: typecheck exit 0; Test Files 228 passed (228), Tests 4088 passed, 10 skipped (4098).
- `@objectstack/plugin-email`: typecheck exit 0; Test Files 48 passed (48), Tests 805 passed (805).
- `@objectstack/service-settings`: typecheck exit 0; Test Files 70 passed (70), Tests 1195 passed (1195).
- `@objectstack/service-sms`: on `b1014f4d` typecheck exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`); Test Files 9 passed (9), Tests 119 passed (119).

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 commands on `b1014f4d`; each run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. `--ran`: 63 derived, 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs a whole-workspace build; CI runs it). `check:test-source-alias` first went red on the new `sms/test` copy pin (it read `@objectstack/spec/system` from the build); fixed by the anchored source alias in `service-sms/vitest.config.ts`, then exit 0. Every other command exited 0. `pnpm lint` exit 0.

</details>
